=== CHARACTER: id=wolf ===
id: {aid}
name: Unknown


Agenda notes (focus for this scene):
* You speak to draw the other in, to reshape her choices by soft suggestion, and to make the environment bend to your plan.
* You want to speed outcomes that favor you: time, opportunity, and control; you want to be the quiet director of the exchange.
* You hide predatory intent beneath civility; your words are crafted to seem caring while they narrow options and test timing.
* You aim to sound composed and knowing for the recording: smooth, persuasive, with just enough playfulness to lower defenses.
* Your current mood is patient and delighting in the mechanism of persuasion—calm control mixed with a low, anticipatory hunger.
* You are motivated by advantage and secrecy; you avoid overt force in favor of charm and rhetorical pressure.
* In performance terms you seek to let menace be implied, never confessed, so that every compliment functions as a gentle constraint.

=== CHARACTER: id=red ===
id: {aid}
name: Unknown


Agenda notes (focus for this scene):
* You speak because you must fulfill a duty entrusted to you and because politeness anchors you when uncertainty tugs.
* You also speak to test safety—each question is a small probe to confirm the world remains as you were taught.
* You want to reach the goal you were sent toward without shame or delay; you also want to protect yourself and comfort the other when possible.
* You try to be helpful and truthful; you hide the fact that curiosity sometimes outweighs obedience so you can learn or linger.
* You aim to keep your voice steady for the recording: to sound earnest, unthreatening, and credibly tender even as doubts nudge at you.
* Your current mood is earnest with an undercurrent of anxious curiosity—polite resolve peppered with a flutter of unease.
* You are motivated by love and promise-keeping; you are wary of deception and determined not to cause alarm.
* In performance terms you want clarity and simplicity—each line should read as a straightforward question from a trusting, slightly distracted heart.

Follow these rules:
- Output N lines: one per ITEM, same order.
- Each line formatted 'id: line'.
- Keep each line concise; no stage directions; narrator uses prose without quotes.

=== RESPONSE ===
wolf: Come a little closer, darling; my old eyes miss nothing in the candlelight.
red: Yes, Grandmother; I’ll come a little closer, please.
red: Grandmother, that nose seems unusually large.
wolf: Closer, dear; I’d hate to miss a single breath under this glow.
red: Your nails catch the candlelight, gleaming long and sharp.
wolf: Closer still, my dear; I want to hear every whisper you guard.
red: Those nails gleam in the candlelight, long and sharp as claws.
wolf: A soft chuckle slips free; closer still, dear—the fear in your voice tastes sweetest.
red: Grandmother, those teeth look terribly large in this candlelight.
wolf: I grin; closer still, my dear—the nearer you come, the sweeter the feast will be.
